summary: Enable real-time sharing to work even when the app is not open, by running in the background.
architectural_notes: Real-time sharing should support background execution (platform-appropriate background service/tasks and permissions).

existing_features.title: Implement best-effort background live location sharing so that, after a child enables live location sharing, location updates can continue even when the app is not in the foreground (and, where the platform supports it, even after the tab/app UI is closed).

Add PWA support (web app manifest + service worker registration) and attempt periodic/background sync approaches where available, to continue submitting location updates when the UI is closed, while keeping behavior safe and permission-respecting.

Update all user-facing copy and transparency/consent messaging to accurately reflect the new background behavior, including the transparency policy section that currently states the app does not collect data in the background.

new_feature_requests.summary: Allow real-time sharing to continue in the background (app does not need to be open).

projectName: Enable best-effort background live location sharing (no need to keep the app open)
